results.description:
Worst. First. Day. Ever.

In the glamorous world of designer fashion, secrets are always in style.

Former fashion buyer Samantha Kidd thought she had her future perfectly tailored—until she discovers her boss dead on the job. When evidence points the police in her direction, Samantha finds herself trading couture for chaos and designer labels for dirty laundry.

Determined to clear her name, Samantha digs into the cutthroat fashion world she thought she'd left behind. Surrounded by ambitious designers, hidden rivalries, and more than a few sharp elbows, this flatfoot in heels must unravel a deadly plot before she's framed for murder.

Smart, stylish, and laugh-out-loud funny, Designer Dirty Laundry launches the Killer Fashion Mysteries, perfect for readers who love reinvention, friendship, and solving crimes with wit, wardrobe savvy, and a healthy dose of humor.

Start Samantha Kidd's journey where it all begins.
